overall_goal: Weigh and log the ingredients while preparing the workspace for cooking.

goals.rationale: The person opens the refrigerator to move a jar of Nutella to a different shelf.

goals.description: Set up the notebook and record initial recipe details
goals.rationale: The person prepares the notebook and pen to start logging the ingredients and recipe steps.
The person cuts open the onion packaging, takes out an onion, and stores the rest in a drawer.

goals.description: Set up the weighing scale and record the weight of onions
goals.rationale: The person places the weighing balance on the table, weighs the onions, and writes down the measurement.

goals.description: Record the weight of tomatoes and recipe ingredients
goals.rationale: The person wraps the tomatoes, turns on the scale, and logs their weight along with other ingredients.

goals.description: Wipe hands and record recipe details
goals.rationale: The person dries their hands with a tablecloth before continuing to write in the notebook.

goals.description: Record ingredients and the weight of green chillies
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly uses the pen and notebook to log the ingredients and the weight of the green chillies.

goals.description: Find garlic and record its weight
goals.rationale: The person searches for garlic in a drawer, places it on the scale, and writes down its weight.

goals.description: Manage the mixer jar and electrical plugs
goals.rationale: The person places garlic in the mixer jar, handles the lid, and switches electrical plugs in the socket.

goals.description: Clean hands and the weighing scale
goals.rationale: The person uses a tablecloth to wipe their hands dry and clean the surface of the weighing balance.

goals.description: Record the weight of cottage cheese and recipe details
goals.rationale: The person picks up the pen to log the weight of the cottage cheese and further recipe instructions.
The person collects onion peels and throws away the plastic packaging of the cottage cheese.
